easyPrerequisites: You have three or less opponents.
description:
Activate Myojin of Roaring Blades by removing an indestructible counter from it.
Holding priority, cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Resolve the Myojin of Roaring Blades ability, dealing 7 damage to each of up to three opponents.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.
